phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock

zh.headline: 瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮：1934 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 是二十世纪最伟大的中口径防空机炮：身管后坐与复进全过程驱动垂直立楔炮闩开闭、抛壳与自动推弹，装填手只需源源不断从顶部漏斗插入 4 发桥夹即可保持每分钟 120 发持续防空火网。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Bofors 40mm 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1934 年问世的 瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 由瑞典瑞典博福斯兵工厂（AB Bofors）主导研制，定位为经典的40mm 自动高射机炮。二战期间同盟国与轴心国双方均广泛列装博福斯 40mm 高炮，美军仅在战舰与陆军就装备了逾 39,000 门，其后继型号至今仍在 AC-130 炮艇机与现代步战车上服役。
瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 是二十世纪最伟大的中口径防空机炮：身管后坐与复进全过程驱动垂直立楔炮闩开闭、抛壳与自动推弹，装填手只需源源不断从顶部漏斗插入 4 发桥夹即可保持每分钟 120 发持续防空火网。 整件装备总长 4,100 mm（炮身与炮架总长）、空重 1980 kg，成为同期航空重武领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1934 年，瑞典瑞典博福斯兵工厂（AB Bofors）推出了划时代的瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮。二战期间同盟国与轴心国双方均广泛列装博福斯 40mm 高炮，美军仅在战舰与陆军就装备了逾 39,000 门，其后继型号至今仍在 AC-130 炮艇机与现代步战车上服役。 它的核心设计聚焦于外露式同轴大型复进簧套筒与标志性锥形喇叭膛口消焰器，奠定了其在航空重武发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 炮尾摇架与耳轴承力机匣

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 的机械灵魂在于其「管退式长后坐自动机 · 垂直立楔炮闩 · 顶部 4 发桥夹连续供弹」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长后坐炮管复进过程中自动驱动立楔炮闩并由顶部弹夹连续重力供弹，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物精加工而成。顶部垂直重力供弹漏斗支持 4 发桥夹不停火无缝续弹，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 采用管退式长后坐自动机 · 垂直立楔炮闩 · 顶部 4 发桥夹连续供弹。在每个击发周期中，长后坐炮管复进过程中自动驱动立楔炮闩并由顶部弹夹连续重力供弹。借助橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了顶部垂直重力供弹漏斗支持 4 发桥夹不停火无缝续弹。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 40×311mmR Bofors HE-T / AP-T 弹药规格与 2,250 mm（名义 L/60 · 16 条渐速右旋膛线 · 喇叭消焰器），最高工作膛压约 310 MPa，可赋予弹头 881 m/s 的出膛初速与 349,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 4800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，16 条右旋渐速膛线快换身管，配备标志性锥形喇叭膛口消焰器与螺旋复进簧。同时，复进末端自动压弹入膛并由机械杠杆联动击发，结构精密耐用，令其在 120 发/分（不间断续夹连射） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 2250 毫米身管与 40×311mmR Bofors HE-T / AP-T 口径，瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 实现了每秒 881 米的初速与 4800 米有效射程。16 条右旋渐速膛线快换身管，配备标志性锥形喇叭膛口消焰器与螺旋复进簧，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 4 发容量的顶部 4 发漏夹重力供弹斗与 1250 mm 膛轴设计，瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 将单发后坐冲量控制在 1120 N·s 水平。快换身管闭锁套环可在激烈防空作战中 30 秒完成热管更换。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-99）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 4 发容量的顶部 4 发漏夹重力供弹斗与出色的整体工效，快换身管闭锁套环可在激烈防空作战中 30 秒完成热管更换。欢迎在 BAY-99 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 瑞典博福斯 40mm L/60 自动高射炮 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Bofors 40mm
paragraphs: Introduced in 1934 by AB Bofors in Sweden, the Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon emerged as a defining 40mm Automatic Anti-Aircraft Gun. Adopted by both Allied and Axis forces in WWII—with over 39,000 built for US forces alone—the Bofors 40mm lineage continues to serve today aboard AC-130 gunships and modern IFVs.

Arguably the finest medium anti-aircraft gun of the 20th century, the Swedish Bofors 40mm L/60 harnesses full barrel recoil and hydro-spring counter-recoil to cycle its vertical sliding-wedge breech while loaders drop 4-round clips continuously into the top hopper at 120 RPM. Measuring 4,100 mm (Mounted Length) at an unloaded weight of 1980 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Aviation & Heavy Ordnance class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1934, AB Bofors of Sweden introduced the Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon. Adopted by both Allied and Axis forces in WWII—with over 39,000 built for US forces alone—the Bofors 40mm lineage continues to serve today aboard AC-130 gunships and modern IFVs. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Exposed concentric recuperator spring sleeve and signature flared flash cone — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon sits its Long-Recoil Hydro-Spring Autocannon · Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · 4-Round Top Clips. Throughout every firing cycle, long-recoil barrel runout cycles the vertical sliding breech and feeds continuous 4-round top clips, containing 310 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Top vertical feed hopper accepts 4-round clips continuously without halting fire, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon relies on Long-Recoil Hydro-Spring Autocannon · Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · 4-Round Top Clips. During each cycle, long-recoil barrel runout cycles the vertical sliding breech and feeds continuous 4-round top clips. Machined from OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Top vertical feed hopper accepts 4-round clips continuously without halting fire.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 40×311mmR Bofors HE-T / AP-T with 2,250 mm (Nominal L/60 · 16-Groove RH · Flared Flash Cone), the Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon develops 881 m/s muzzle velocity and 349,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 4800 meters.

Internally, Quick-change 16-groove RH rifled barrel with iconic flared flash cone and concentric recuperator spring. Combined with its 120 RPM (continuous clip-fed) tempo, Counter-recoil ramming and vertical sliding-wedge lock enable 120 RPM sustained fire, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 40×311mmR Bofors HE-T / AP-T through its 2250 millimeter bore, the Bofors 40mm L/60 Autocannon achieves 881 meters per second and 4800 meters of effective reach. Quick-change 16-groove RH rifled barrel with iconic flared flash cone and concentric recuperator spring.

Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-99), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
